purpose: Listening pack of real Waveyard mashups for human assessment. These are actual renders from the production planner and mix bus, not synthetic fixtures.
listenerAssessment: NOT PERFORMED — this pack exists so a human can do it. No automated score here is a quality claim.
inputs: Vocals: MTG turkish-makam-solo-voice dataset (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/MTG/turkish-makam-acapella-sections-dataset). Beds: AERIS MUSIC CC0 instrumentals (https://github.com/farmmer938-lgtm/aeris-cc0-music).
inputsArePreSeparated: The vocal side is unaccompanied singing and the bed side is an instrumental, so both are already isolated. No separation model was run — none could be downloaded in this environment — and that is recorded here so nobody assumes the separation stage was exercised.
